title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Ava Patel
release_notes:
- Improved dedicated autoscaler burst control metrics and added per-fleet utilization reporting.
- Exposes token-bucket and burst-window metrics to console and alerting rules.
- No user-facing API changes; safely enable via config flag.
description:
Context: Customers running Dedicated fleets hit opaque burst behavior and lacked actionable per-fleet utilization metrics. This PR enhances the autoscaler to emit richer burst-control and utilization metrics, plus a lightweight reporting pipeline to surface those metrics in the Redwood Console.

Summary:
- Add per-fleet token_bucket.{capacity,available,refill_rate} metrics and burst_window.{requests,avg_latency,p99_latency}.
- Emit fleet_utilization.{gpu_pct,request_pct,queued_pct} with 1m/5m aggregates.
- New reporting worker that aggregates these metrics and writes a summarized daily utilization report used by Console and PagerDuty alerts.
- Backwards-compatible toggle: feature flag "enable_enhanced_burst_reporting". Default: off for safety.

Design notes:
- Metrics are emitted from the autoscaler main loop to avoid additional QPS to the serving runtime. Token-bucket state is sampled at commit points. Aggregation worker uses a bounded in-memory window and flushes to metrics-store and S3 summarization.
- Reporting schema is intentionally flat and append-only to simplify downstream dashboards and historical comparisons.
- We avoided changing request routing or throttle logic in this PR; only visibility and observability. Follow-up PR will surface recommended autoscaler tuning suggestions.

Checklist: 
- [x] Metrics emitted from autoscaler loop
- [x] Aggregation worker implemented with backpressure handling
- [x] Console endpoints + minimal dashboard panels wired to new metrics
- [x] Unit tests for metric serialization and feature flag gating
- [x] E2E smoke test against local metrics-store (CI)
- [x] Docs stub in redwood-docs for rollout notes

Testing:
- Unit tests added for token bucket sampling and report generation (autoscaler and reporting-worker).
- Integration test in perf-canary validated that enabling the feature does not change steady-state throughput for a 1h load test.
- CI flaked on a metrics-store timeout on first run; retried and all checks passed.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge behind feature flag off.
2) Canary enable on internal small fleet for 24h and validate metrics fidelity and Console panels.
3) Gradually enable for customers with Dedicated fleets with opt-in via Console.

Notes: This change is observability-first and intended to make autoscaler tuning and incident triage faster. Follow-ups: autoscaler tuning recommendations UI and automatic alert suggestions (ENG-2001).

review_comments: Miguel Santos: Can we ensure the metrics emission path is non-blocking? Autoscaler loop must not be delayed by metrics store latency.
Ava Patel: Metrics emission is buffered with a 1k bounded channel; on full we sample-drop and increment metrics.emit_drops. Added backpressure handling in reporting_worker.

Eleanor Kim: Small nit: prefer 5m aggregates for utilization to reduce noise.
Ava Patel: Kept both 1m and 5m aggregates; Console shows 5m by default.

Ravi Desai: CI flake on metrics-store timeout — re-run CI once storage mock fixed.
Ava Patel: Re-ran CI after increasing mock timeout; all green now.
